name: project-standards
description: Opinionated cross-domain project engineering standards, catalog binding, conditional applicability, and audit workflows.

interface.longDescription: Project Standards provides independently selectable capability contracts for project structure, instructions, documentation, Python, APIs, persistence, identity, frontend, deployment, standardization, and semantic audit.
defaultPrompt: Classify which declared standards apply to the current project and task.
